scope: spline pion_sector/pipS2o on variation shard 1. 3D Bayesian phi_h, 421 fitted cells, Q2-y 1-17. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. 31 empty histograms are N/A, including (12,8), (12,24), (3,4), (3,5).
start_mode: manual. Spline B windows are tight (median width 0.020, 945 of 1390 narrower than 0.05), so --use_spline_init was not used. Changed bins are in refine_init.py, a copy of nominal_init.py.
changed: Initial run_shard was not treated as finished. 13 bins were trapped by a small first-pass moment start: the second pass only moves a parameter halfway, so A(1+B cos phi+C cos 2phi) was too flat. Starts were moved to the histogram cosine and limits that excluded it were widened in refine_init.py. Remade Q2-y 2 9 10 13 14 16 with --unfolding_3D --fit_corrections Bayesian --fit_error_source histogram --fit_init_file, no pass cap and no chi-squared stop. All 13 improved. Worst (10,17) 6.88 to 1.20. Other cells in those Q2-y bins did not move, and unselected Q2-y bins are unchanged. JSON still has 421 cells. The shared manual initializer and the universal spline file were not edited.
left_bins: No 5D family, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Histogram shapes that disagree with a neighbor were kept, including (2,6) B -0.451 beside neighbor -0.015; (13,2) B -0.218 beside neighbor -0.033.
unresolved: The best three-parameter curve still misses the histogram in (8,30) free_diverged. Further guide changes do not help those bins. Empty histograms stay N/A and are not zeroes. Pre-existing failed-rule bins were not created by the guide edit and were not counted as improvements: (12,14), (3,24), (4,15), (7,33), (8,25), (8,30). They stay out of any RMS.
